from(bucket: "telemetry_main")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "BPS_Fault" or r._field == "BPS_Charge_OK" or r._field == "BPS_Regen_OK" or r._field == "BPS_Segment0_Status" or r._field == "BPS_Segment1_Status" or r._field == "BPS_Segment2_Status" or r._field == "BPS_Segment3_Status" or r._field == "BPS_Segment4_Status" or r._field == "BPS_Segment5_Status" or r._field == "BPS_Segment6_Status" or r._field == "BPS_Segment7_Status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vehicle == "HighNoon")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
